spl_product_data_elements: Triple Antibiotic Bacitracin zinc, Neomycin sulfate , Polymyxin B sulfate. LIGHT MINERAL OIL WHITE PETROLATUM BACITRACIN ZINC BACITRACIN NEOMYCIN SULFATE NEOMYCIN POLYMYXIN B SULFATE POLYMYXIN B
active_ingredient: Active ingredients (each gram contains) Bacitracin zinc 400 units Neomycin sulfate 3.5 mg Polymyxin B sulfate 5,000 units
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
indications_and_usage: Uses first aid to help prevent infection in minor:● cuts ● scrapes ● burns
ask_doctor: Ask Doctor Before Use Ask Doctor before use if you have deep or puncture wounds, animal bites, or serious burns.
do_not_use: Do Not Use In the eyes Over large areas of the body If you are allergic to any of the ingredients
stop_use: Stop Use and ask a doctor Stop Use and ask a doctor if Condition persists or gets worse You need to use longer than 1 week A rash or other allergic reaction develops
dosage_and_administration: Directions ● clean the affected area and dry thoroughly. ● apply a small amount of this product (an amount equal to the surface area of the tip of a finger) on the area 1 to 3 times daily ● may be covered with a sterile bandage.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredient light Mineral Oil, White Petrolatum
spl_unclassified_section: Other information ● store at 20° to 25°C ( 68° to 77°F)
